how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online only, through one of the official websites, between 5 August 2026 (10:00 AM) and 31 August 2026 (Midnight). No other mode of application is accepted.
Visit any of the official websites: energy.rajasthan.gov.in, or the Nigam-specific portals (rrvun, rrvpn, jvvnl, jdvvnl, avvnl).
Click "APPLY ONLINE," then "CLICK HERE FOR NEW REGISTRATION" and enter your Name, Contact details and Email ID to generate a Provisional Registration Number and Password (also sent by email/SMS).
Fill the application form, using "SAVE AND NEXT" to save progress; carefully verify all details, as no change is possible after clicking "FINAL SUBMIT."

Upload scanned Photograph (4.5cm x 3.5cm), Signature (black ink, not in capital letters), Left Thumb Impression, and a Hand Written Declaration (in English, in the candidate's own handwriting) as per the specifications in the official advertisement. A Live Photograph must also be captured via webcam or mobile phone.
Indicate your preference of Companies (RVUN/RVPN/JVVN/AVVN/JdVVN) - this preference is final and irrevocable, with no second opportunity for change.
Preview the application, click "FINAL SUBMIT," then proceed to the "Payment" tab and pay the applicable fee online.
Take a printout of the E-Receipt and the submitted Online Application Form for future reference - these are required at the time of Documents Verification.

A candidate may apply for more than one different post, but not submit multiple applications for the same post (only the latest valid application is retained in case of duplication, and fees paid for earlier attempts are forfeited).

Candidates should regularly check the official websites and their registered email for recruitment updates; no information will be sent by post or any other mode. content_sections.heading: RVUN Recruitment 2026 – Participating Power Companies
content_sections.text: The recruitment covers five wholly Government-of-Rajasthan-owned Power Companies, formed on 19 July 2000, engaged in Generation, Transmission and Distribution of electricity across the state. The Ministerial Staff Service Regulations, 2017 govern Junior Accountant and Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II; the Engineers Service Regulations, 2016 govern Junior Engineer-I. The Scheduled Areas Engineers, Ministerial & Class-IV Service (Recruitment & other Service Conditions) Regulations, 2017 also apply where relevant.

content_sections.heading: RVUN Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a single Computer-Based common written competitive exam (Online mode), of 2 hours' duration, consisting only of Objective Type (MCQ) questions, with negative marking for wrong answers and no interview. Part A (60% weightage): For Junior Engineer-I, this is at Degree-in-Engineering level in the candidate's discipline. For Junior Accountant, this covers Corporate Accounting, Income Tax, Cost Accounting, Theory & Practice of Auditing, and Management Accounting/Advanced Cost Accounting/Cost & Management Audit/Computer Application in Accounting/Taxation Law & Practice/Advanced Financial Accounting, at Graduation Degree level. Part B (40% weightage): Reasoning & Mental Ability; Mathematics (Class-XII level for JE-I, Class-X level for Junior Accountant); General Knowledge & Everyday Science (with special reference to Rajasthan); Hindi General (Class-X level); English General (Class-X level). Minimum qualifying marks: 30% for UR candidates, 20% for SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS/Ex-servicemen/PWBD(PH) candidates, in each part. Selection is in two phases, with no interview: Phase-I (Computer Based Test): Stage-1 Pre-examination (screening only, no weightage in final merit) followed by Stage-2 Main-examination. Both are Objective/MCQ, covering Reasoning & Mental Ability, Mathematics (Class-X level), General Knowledge & Everyday Science, Hindi General (Class-X level) and English General (Class-X level). About 10 times the number of vacancies are admitted to the Main-examination from the Pre-examination merit list (with relaxed standards applied for reserved categories where needed to ensure adequate representation). Phase-II (Type Writing Test): For candidates other than PWBD - Hindi typing on computer (Speed Test: 10 minutes/25 marks; Efficiency Test: 10 minutes/25 marks) and English typing on computer (Speed Test: 10 minutes/25 marks; Efficiency Test: 10 minutes/25 marks). PWBD candidates are instead given the average marks obtained in the Main-examination of Phase-I in place of the Type Writing Test. Final merit is based on 40% weightage to Main-examination marks and 60% weightage to Phase-II (Type Writing Test) marks. There is no negative marking in the Pre-examination, but there is negative marking in the Main-examination. Minimum qualifying marks: 30% for UR, 20% for SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS/Ex-servicemen/PWBD(PH) candidates. For all three posts, if two or more candidates secure equal marks, the elder candidate (by date of birth) is placed higher in the merit list; for Junior Engineer-I, candidates who completed apprenticeship training in a Vidyut Nigam under the Apprentices Act, 1961 are given preference within that Nigam in case of a tie.

content_sections.heading: RVUN Recruitment 2026 Documents Verification
content_sections.text: Successful candidates, limited to about 2 times the vacancies in each category for each post/discipline, will be called for Documents Verification in order of merit. Candidates must bring original documents along with two self-attested photocopies, including (among others): the system-generated application printout, E-Receipt of fee, Degree/Provisional Degree or Institute Certificate, all mark-sheets, Senior Secondary/Secondary certificates (for date of birth), category certificates (SC/ST/EWS/BC/MBC, as applicable, issued by a Rajasthan competent authority only), PWBD medical certificate (if applicable), marriage/divorce/widowhood documents (if applicable), an affidavit regarding number of children, a Bonafide Resident Certificate, a character certificate, an affidavit regarding pending/past criminal cases, and an Employment Certificate or NOC if already employed in government service. Failure to appear for verification on the scheduled date leads to automatic rejection of candidature.

faq.question: Q1. What is RVUN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a Common Recruitment Exercise by five State Power Companies of Rajasthan — RVUN, RVPN, JVVN, AVVN and JdVVN — for 2,005 posts of Junior Engineer-I, Junior Accountant and Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in RVUN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2,005 vacancies are notified: 869 for Junior Engineer-I (727 Electrical, 110 Mechanical, 32 Civil), 371 for Junior Accountant, and 765 for Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for RVUN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 31 August 2026 at 12:00 Midnight. Applications opened on 5 August 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for RVUN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Junior Engineer-I requires a full-time 4-year Engineering Degree (or AMIE) in the relevant discipline; Junior Accountant requires a Commerce/Business Administration graduation (or equivalent professional qualification) plus a computer qualification; Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II requires Senior Secondary (12th) plus a computer qualification. Full detail is in the Eligibility section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for RVUN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Junior Accountant and Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II candidates must be 18 to 40 years old (relaxed to 43 years due to no recruitment in the previous 3 years). Junior Engineer-I candidates must be 21 to 40 years old (up to 43 years for RVPN posts), reckoned as on 01-01-2027, with additional category-based relaxation.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for RVUN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs.1,000/- for UR (General) candidates and Rs.500/- for SC/ST/BC/MBC/EWS/PWBD(PH)/Saharias candidates, both including GST and non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for RVUN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online only, through energy.rajasthan.gov.in or the relevant Nigam sub-portal, between 5 and 31 August 2026, uploading photograph, signature, left thumb impression and a handwritten declaration as specified, and paying the application fee online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for RVUN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Junior Engineer-I and Junior Accountant candidates take a single Computer-Based Test with no interview. Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II candidates go through a Pre-examination, a Main-examination, and a Type Writing Test (Hindi and English), also with no interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for RVUN Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Post-probation minimum basic pay is Rs.33,800/- per month (Level-10) for Junior Engineer-I and Junior Accountant, and Rs.20,800/- per month (Level-5) for Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II, plus allowances. During the 2-year Probation Training period, fixed remuneration is Rs.23,700/- (JE-I & Junior Accountant) or Rs.14,600/- (Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II) per month.

faq.question: What is the salary for RVUN Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Post-probation minimum basic pay is Rs.33,800/- per month (Level-10) for Junior Engineer-I and Junior Accountant, and Rs.20,800/- per month (Level-5) for Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II, plus allowances. During the 2-year Probation Training period, fixed remuneration is Rs.23,700/- (JE-I & Junior Accountant) or Rs.14,600/- (Junior Assistant/Commercial Assistant-II) per month.
